# Host Census + Signal Coverage v3

Compares **active OneAgent hosts** (emitting host metrics) now vs **7 / 30 / 90 days ago**, shows **Missing / Added** diffs in three **Changes** tables (columns: `name`, `status`, `change_date`), signal coverage (metrics, disk, network, process, logs, traces, services), and OneAgent health.

**Active** = host reported `dt.host.cpu.usage` in the window (not merely present as an entity). Silent agent stopovers disappear from metrics — that is the failure mode this dashboard catches.

**Alerting:** workflow `Host Dropout Alert v1` (`c4cd2545-fd46-4474-9db7-0ac9f877c68f`) opens a Dynatrace Problem after ~**1 hour** of silence. Daily `Host Census Snapshot v1` (`a2117875-d1f9-441c-b54a-5fc44b760122`) stores durable census events for long-term history.

Scroll to the **bottom** for full documentation (workflows, Problems, exclusions, limits).

1.title: Active Now
1.query:
timeseries cpu = avg(dt.host.cpu.usage), by:{dt.entity.host}, from:now()-2h, interval:1h
| summarize `Active Now` = countDistinct(dt.entity.host)

2.title: Missing vs 7d
2.query:
timeseries cpu = avg(dt.host.cpu.usage), by:{dt.entity.host}, from:now()-2h, interval:1h
| fieldsAdd host = entityName(dt.entity.host), active_now = 1
| fields host_id = dt.entity.host, host, active_now
| append [
  timeseries cpu = avg(dt.host.cpu.usage), by:{dt.entity.host}, from:now()-7d-2h, to:now()-7d, interval:1h
  | fieldsAdd host = entityName(dt.entity.host), active_past = 1
  | fields host_id = dt.entity.host, host, active_past
]
| summarize
    active_now = takeMax(active_now),
    active_past = takeMax(active_past),
    host = takeAny(host),
    by:{host_id}
| fieldsAdd status = if(coalesce(active_past, 0) == 1 and coalesce(active_now, 0) == 0, "Missing", else:if(coalesce(active_past, 0) == 0 and coalesce(active_now, 0) == 1, "Added", else:"Still active"))
| fields host, host_id, status, active_now = coalesce(active_now, 0), active_past = coalesce(active_past, 0)
| sort host asc
| filter status == "Missing"
| summarize `Missing` = count()

| filter in(status, "Missing", "Added")

  | fields host_id = dt.entity.host, metric_last
], sourceField:host_id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{metric_last}

  timeseries cpu = avg(dt.host.cpu.usage), by:{dt.entity.host}, from:now()-14d, interval:24h

    else: formatTimestamp(coalesce(metric_first, entity_first), format:"yyyy-MM-dd"))

15.query:
timeseries cpu = avg(dt.host.cpu.usage), by:{dt.entity.host}, from:now()-2h, interval:1h
| fieldsAdd host = entityName(dt.entity.host), active_now = 1
| fields host_id = dt.entity.host, host, active_now

  | fieldsAdd host = entityName(dt.entity.host), a30 = 1

  timeseries cpu = avg(dt.host.cpu.usage), by:{dt.entity.host}, from:now()-90d-2h, to:now()-90d, interval:1h
  | fieldsAdd host = entityName(dt.entity.host), a90 = 1
  | fields host_id = dt.entity.host, host, a90
]
| summarize
    active_now = takeMax(active_now),
    a7 = takeMax(a7),
    a30 = takeMax(a30),
    a90 = takeMax(a90),
    host = takeAny(host),
    by:{host_id}
| fieldsAdd
    status_7d = if(coalesce(a7, 0) == 1 and coalesce(active_now, 0) == 0, "Missing", else:if(coalesce(a7, 0) == 0 and coalesce(active_now, 0) == 1, "Added", else:"Still active")),
    status_30d = if(coalesce(a30, 0) == 1 and coalesce(active_now, 0) == 0, "Missing", else:if(coalesce(a30, 0) == 0 and coalesce(active_now, 0) == 1, "Added", else:"Still active")),
    status_90d = if(coalesce(a90, 0) == 1 and coalesce(active_now, 0) == 0, "Missing", else:if(coalesce(a90, 0) == 0 and coalesce(active_now, 0) == 1, "Added", else:"Still active"))
| lookup [
  fetch dt.entity.host
  | fields host_id = id, installerVersion, monitoringMode, osType
], sourceField:host_id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{installerVersion, monitoringMode, osType}
| fields host, host_id, status_7d, status_30d, status_90d, installerVersion, monitoringMode, osType, active_now = coalesce(active_now, 0)
| sort host asc

16.title: Signal coverage — now vs 7d ago

17.title: OneAgent versions (distribution)
17.query:
fetch dt.entity.host
| filter isNotNull(installerVersion)
| summarize hosts = count(), by:{installerVersion}
| sort installerVersion desc

18.title: OneAgent versions by host
18.query:
fetch dt.entity.host
| filter isNotNull(installerVersion)
| fields host = entity.name, host_id = id, oneagent_version = installerVersion, monitoring_mode = monitoringMode, state
| fieldsAdd host_sprint = toLong(arrayElement(splitString(oneagent_version, "."), 1)), join_key = "baseline"
| join [
  fetch events
  | filter startsWith(event.name, "OneAgentBaseline|")
  | sort timestamp desc
  | limit 1
  | fieldsAdd parts = splitString(event.name, "|")
  | fields oldest_supported_version = arrayElement(parts, 2)
  | fieldsAdd oldest_supported_sprint = toLong(arrayElement(splitString(oldest_supported_version, "."), 1)), join_key = "baseline"
], on: join_key
| fieldsAdd support_alert = host_sprint < right.oldest_supported_sprint
| fields host, host_id, oneagent_version, support_alert, monitoring_mode, state
| sort host asc

19.title: Host dropout Problems / alerts (7d)
19.query:
fetch events, from:now()-7d
| filter event.kind == "DAVIS_EVENT" or event.type == "CUSTOM_ALERT"
| filter contains(event.name, "Host dropout") or contains(toString(host_dropout_key), "host-dropout:") or matchesPhrase(event.name, "Host dropout")
| fields timestamp, event.name, event.status, event.type, host_dropout_key, host_name, host_id, silence_minutes, installerVersion
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 100

# Documentation — Host Census + Signal Coverage v1

## Purpose
Hosts can stop reporting into Dynatrace and **drop silently** from metric-only views (entity may linger; timeseries simply omit the host). This dashboard and its workflows make dropouts, additions, and signal gaps visible — the motivating case was host `www`.

## Definitions
- **Active (now):** host emitted `dt.host.cpu.usage` in the last ~2 hours.
- **Active (Nd ago):** host emitted that metric in a ~2h slice around `now()-Nd`.
- **Missing:** active in the past window, not active now.
- **Added:** active now, not active in the past window.
- **Still active:** in both windows.
- **Weak signals:** active hosts missing logs or traces in the last 24h (not necessarily unhealthy).

## Dashboard sections
1. Overview (this family of tiles)
2. KPI strip — active now, missing/added vs 7/30/90d, weak signals
3. Changes tables per bucket (7/30/90d) — columns: `name`, `status` (Missing/Added), `change_date` (gone-missing ≈ last report; added ≈ first report in recent stretch)
4. Full census with status vs each bucket + OneAgent version / mode / OS
5. Signal coverage — now vs 7d-ago columns (Y/N); Frontends often `n/a` (RUM is usually app-scoped)
6. OneAgent version distribution and per-host support vs ESS baseline event
7. Recent host-dropout Problems / CUSTOM_ALERT events
8. This documentation

## Workflows
### Host Census Snapshot v1
- **Schedule:** daily (UTC)
- **Action:** queries active hosts + attributes + 24h signal flags; ingests one `CUSTOM_ANNOTATION` per host titled `host.census.daily|<host>|<date>` plus a summary event
- **Why:** durable history if metric retention ever shrinks; backup for 90d comparisons
- **Does not** create Problems

### Host Dropout Alert v1
- **Schedule:** every 15 minutes
- **Logic:** host was active in ~prior day window (`now()-25h` → `now()-1h`) but has **no** host metrics in the last **1 hour**
- **Action:** ingest `CUSTOM_ALERT` titled `Host dropout: <hostname>` attached to the host entity
- **Keep-alive:** re-ingests while still missing (stable `host_dropout_key` = `host-dropout:<HOST-ID>`) so Davis keeps one Problem open
- **Close:** when host reports again, keep-alives stop; Problem closes after event timeout (~45 minutes). Optional restore `CUSTOM_INFO` is emitted.
- **Exclude:** tag host with `host-dropout:ignore` to suppress alerting (intentional decommission)

## Problems
- **Type:** `CUSTOM_ALERT` (Davis Problem-capable)
- **Title:** `Host dropout: <hostname>`
- **Key properties:** `host_dropout_key`, `host_id`, `host_name`, `last_seen_hint`, `silence_minutes`, `installerVersion`, `monitoringMode`, signal summary fields, `source=host-dropout-alert-v1`
- **Entity:** `entitySelector` = `type(HOST),entityId("<HOST-ID>")`
- **Timeout:** ~45 minutes (refresh every 15m while missing)
- **Notifications:** Problems appear in the Problems app. Phone/email/Slack require an alerting profile that includes these `CUSTOM_ALERT` events.

## Related resources
- Observability Health dashboards — CMDB expected inventory vs Dynatrace (complementary; not time-window census)
- OneAgent Version Compliance — installer version vs ESS baseline
- Artifacts: `dynatrace-private-ops/dashboards/host-census-signal-coverage-v1.yaml`, `dynatrace-private-ops/workflows/host-census-snapshot-v1.workflow.json`, `dynatrace-private-ops/workflows/host-dropout-alert-v1.workflow.json`

## Known limits
- Metric retention currently covers 90d in this tenant; census events are still written for resilience.
- Frontends are rarely host-attributable → shown as `n/a`.
- Dashboard tile queries use **fixed** time windows (required for 7/30/90 diffs); the global timeframe picker does not redefine those comparisons.
- Iteration rule: never edit this dashboard in place — create **vN+1**.

- **v3 (2026-08-02):** Simplified Changes tiles to name, status, change_date.
- **v2 (2026-08-02):** Merged six Missing/Added tiles into three Changes tables (status column).
- **v1 (2026-08-02):** Initial Host Census + Signal Coverage dashboard; Host Census Snapshot v1; Host Dropout Alert v1 (~1h silence).
